adjudication.evidence: P1 (685-692) shows a sustained N/E/U shift but no clear return; interior points (e.g., index 687–691) show motion inconsistent with a flat platform. P2 (694–696) is too short and coincides with missing data at 698–703; no opposing return observed. P3 (699–703) overlaps missing indices and lacks persistent interior observations; onset offset suggests step but no recovery. P4 (709–717) shows large offsets, yet original N/E/U (e.g., 709: [6.26281,0.42374,3.42667], 717: [5.52567,-1.85549,2.95019]) do not support a closed loop—U drops then rises, but N/E show monotonic drift without reversal. No candidate satisfies the criterion of sustained shift + opposing return across same axes. Hence, no genuine temporary platform exists in this interval.
